name: Traccar
tagline: Open-source GPS tracking server with REST API for devices, positions, and geofences
description: Traccar is an open-source GPS tracking platform that exposes a full REST API for managing devices, real-time positions, geofences, users, groups, and reports. You can self-host the server or use Traccar Cloud. Authentication is typically session-based (cookie after Basic Auth login) or token-based depending on deployment; the API covers CRUD for tracking entities and historical position/report queries.

auth.details: Session cookie after HTTP Basic Auth login to /api/session, or Authorization: Bearer <token> when tokens are enabled; self-hosted or Traccar Cloud account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Self-host free (open source); Traccar Cloud has free/demo and paid plans — exact free quotas not fully verified here
pricing.paid_plans: Traccar Cloud paid tiers available; self-host is free

use_cases: list GPS devices registered on a Traccar server
get latest position for a tracked device
create or update a geofence for a device group
fetch historical positions or trip reports for a device
register a new tracker by uniqueId
